mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 4.0% compresses corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that depress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and INDPRO fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising for 3 months), reduced liquidity and higher discount rates compress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the tightening cycle condition.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% consistently signals weak labor market conditions that depress consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 2.0% signals contraction in the residential sector, which negatively impacts consumer spending and corporate revenues, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines by >2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a dual shock to supply chains and consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate profit visibility.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer demand (RSAFS rising above 0.5% monthly), improved corporate earnings outlook and risk-on sentiment produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises by >0.5%.
